chat.uncensored.description: Explicit-only local chat role backed by an abliterated Granite 4.1 8B. A 2026-10-21 bake-off against five other abliterated builds scored it highest on instruction following, formatting, and arithmetic (13/14 checks), with a real chat template and a passing live tool smoke. Never a default target: route here only when a caller deliberately asks for unrestricted local generation. Sampling is pinned low for instruction-following and agent work; raise temperature at the call site for creative use.

huihui_ai/granite4.1-abliterated:8b.use_case_notes: Abliterated Granite 4.1 8B at Q4_K_M, selected by the 2026-10-21 abliterated bake-off: 13/14 instruction, formatting, and arithmetic checks; live tool smoke passed; ~99 tok/s at a 20480-token context with no CPU offload.
caveats: Refusal behaviour is reduced by a weight edit; outputs are unreviewed and this model must not be routed by default or exposed to customer-facing scenarios.
20480 tokens is the measured host-fit context (11.13 GiB VRAM, no CPU offload). 24K needs CPU offload; a 24K session under the old parallel=2 default caused a CUDA OOM, so 20K is the safe default.
It advertises tool calling and passed the live tool smoke, but the role requires text chat only. Re-probe tool calling after model updates.
